definition: The main chip in a computer that runs instructions and does calculations.
exampleSentence: The CPU processes millions of instructions every second while you are working.

definition: Short-term memory that holds the data a computer is using right now.
exampleSentence: Opening too many browser tabs at once can quickly fill up your RAM.

definition: A processor built to draw graphics and run many calculations at the same time.
exampleSentence: Modern games and machine learning models need a powerful GPU to run smoothly.

definition: A storage device that keeps your files even when the computer is turned off.
exampleSentence: I saved a copy of all my project files on an external hard drive.

definition: The main circuit board that connects all the parts of a computer together.
exampleSentence: Every component inside the computer case is connected directly to the motherboard.

definition: A screen that shows the pictures and text produced by a computer.
exampleSentence: She bought a larger monitor so she could see more code at once.

definition: A device with keys that you press to type text and give commands.
exampleSentence: My keyboard stopped working after I accidentally spilled coffee all over it.

definition: A computer that provides data or services to other computers over a network.
exampleSentence: The website went down last night because the server ran out of memory.

definition: A step-by-step set of instructions for solving a problem or doing a task.
exampleSentence: This sorting algorithm puts a long list of names in alphabetical order.

definition: A mistake in a program that makes it behave in the wrong way.
exampleSentence: The developer spent two hours trying to find the bug in the login page.

definition: The process of finding and fixing mistakes in code.
exampleSentence: Debugging can take a long time when the error message is not clear.

definition: A program that translates source code into code the computer can run.
exampleSentence: The compiler showed an error because I forgot a semicolon on line ten.

definition: A named place in a program where a value is stored and can change.
exampleSentence: We store the age of the user in a variable so we can use it later.

definition: A reusable block of code that performs one specific task.
exampleSentence: Write a function that takes two numbers and returns the sum of them.

definition: A set of ready-made tools and code that helps you build software faster.
exampleSentence: Our team chose a popular web framework to build the new online store.

definition: A set of rules that lets different programs talk to each other.
exampleSentence: The weather app uses a public API to get the latest forecast data.

definition: The main software that manages the hardware and runs all other programs.
exampleSentence: My old laptop runs the latest version of the operating system without problems.

definition: A program that you use to open and view websites.
exampleSentence: Open your browser and type the address of the website in the top bar.

definition: A device that sends data between networks, such as your home network and the internet.
exampleSentence: If the internet stops working, try restarting the router in the living room.

definition: A unique number that identifies a device on a network.
exampleSentence: Every device that connects to the internet gets its own IP address for communication.

definition: The largest amount of data that a connection can carry in a given time.
exampleSentence: Streaming videos in high quality uses a lot of bandwidth on our home network.

definition: A wireless technology that connects devices to a network without cables.
exampleSentence: The hotel offers free Wi-Fi to all of its guests in every room.

definition: A system that turns website names into the IP addresses computers use.
exampleSentence: When DNS is not working, your browser cannot find websites by their names.

definition: A set of rules that controls how data is sent between devices.
exampleSentence: HTTPS is a secure protocol that protects the data you send to websites.

definition: The delay between sending data and that data arriving at its destination.
exampleSentence: High latency makes online games feel slow and very difficult to play well.

definition: A small piece of data that is sent across a network.
exampleSentence: Each packet travels on its own and is put back together at the end.

definition: A secret word or phrase that proves who you are when you log in.
exampleSentence: You should never share your password with anyone, not even your close friends.

definition: A system that blocks unwanted traffic between a network and the outside world.
exampleSentence: The company firewall blocked the suspicious connection before it could cause any damage.

definition: Harmful software made to damage a computer or steal information from it.
exampleSentence: Downloading files from unknown websites can infect your computer with dangerous malware.

definition: Turning data into a secret code so that only allowed people can read it.
exampleSentence: Strong encryption keeps your messages private even if someone manages to intercept them.

definition: A trick where attackers send fake messages to steal personal information.
exampleSentence: The email looked real, but it was actually a phishing attempt to steal passwords.

definition: A way of logging in that needs two different proofs of who you are.
exampleSentence: Turn on two-factor authentication to make your account much harder to break into.

definition: A copy of data that you keep in case the original is lost or damaged.
exampleSentence: Always make a backup of your important files before you update the system.

definition: A weakness in a system that an attacker could use to cause harm.
exampleSentence: The security team fixed the vulnerability before any attackers were able to use it.

definition: Servers on the internet that store your data and run software for you.
exampleSentence: We moved all our company documents to the cloud so everyone can reach them.

definition: An organized collection of data that is easy to search and update.
exampleSentence: All customer orders are stored in a database that the team checks every day.

definition: A table of rows and columns used to organize and calculate data.
exampleSentence: She created a spreadsheet to track the monthly budget of the whole project.

definition: To copy a file from the internet or a server to your own device.
exampleSentence: Please download the latest version of the app before the meeting starts tomorrow.

definition: To send a file from your own device to the internet or a server.
exampleSentence: It took almost ten minutes to upload the large video to the website.

definition: A named piece of saved information, such as a document, picture or program.
exampleSentence: Remember to give the file a clear name so you can find it later.
